aap.name: Ansible Automation Platform
aap.overview: The Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform workshop series is a set of instructor-led, 3-hour technical workshops covering automation across different domains. Each session includes a hands-on labs environment.

resources.label: Windows Automation — Oct 21, 2026
resources.description: Participants learn the basics of Ansible Automation with Windows Hosts. Covers configuring credentials and inventories, running ad-hoc commands, creating playbooks, advanced playbook methodologies, and Ansible Roles. Geared toward Windows administrators, cloud administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals.

resources.label: Network Automation — Nov 18, 2026
resources.description: Covers Ansible Automation for routers and switches. Attendees learn to pull facts from devices, build templated network configurations, and apply these concepts at scale. Manages a multi-vendor lab environment with Cisco IOS-XE, Arista EOS, and Juniper Junos devices. Best for network engineers, systems administrators, and automation architects.

resources.label: Linux Automation — Dec 16, 2026
resources.description: Walks through Ansible fundamentals on the command line, then applies them in automation controller for enterprise use cases. Write your first playbook, work with variables, templates, collections, then move into inventories, credentials, job templates, surveys, RBAC, workflows, and more. Best for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and anyone interested in IT automation on RHEL.

virt.name: OpenShift Virtualization
virt.overview:
In this three-hour virtual workshop, you will get a tailored, hands-on lab covering OpenShift Virtualization fundamentals, importing and migrating virtual machines, networking, storage, and more. You will create and manage VMs, practice migration concepts with the Migration Toolkit for Virtualization (MTV), and work through day-to-day operations that virt admins encounter in production, including live migration, exposing applications, and backup/restore concepts.

Prior experience with Red Hat OpenShift is not required. Lab access is provided during the session. Space is limited to preserve lab quality.

security.name: OpenShift App Platform (Security)
security.tagline: Policy, compliance, and application security on OpenShift.
